messages:
zoe: Noticing a spike in reconciliation deltas after today's NetSuite push. Several Stripe webhook events that arrived late were attributed to the wrong invoice period.

kai: Can you share a log snippet and count of affected customers?

zoe: Log: ```2026-05-10T03:02:11Z WARN webhook-processor: event=evt_9yX billable_ts=2026-05-09T23:59:50Z delivered_ts=2026-05-10T02:58:03Z batch_window=2026-05-10T02:00:00Z```

zoe: The mapper used batch_window as the period for the whole batch; events with billable_ts before cutoff got pushed forward.

mike_fin: How many customers and any posted invoices? Need exposure ASAP.

zoe: 6 customers impacted; 2 had invoices posted, 3 had auto-credit memos created by NetSuite. I exported details to the private sheet.

kai: Root cause seems to be batcher using batch_received_at instead of event.billable_ts. Quick patch: prefer event.billable_ts for attribution and keep batcher optimization for grouping only. I'll open a PR.

infra-bot: nightly-batch summary 2026-05-10T04:10:00Z - batches=390 events=2,700 failed=3 dlq=6 late_deliveries=9

kai: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/536 "webhook: attribute by event.billable_ts". Includes tests for out-of-order delivery. @zoe please review finance impact.

mike_fin: Please run a staging dry-run backfill before live. We want to ensure no duplicate credits or invoice collisions.

kai: Will run dry-run tonight and post CSV diff. Assigning follow-ups: kai=patch+backfill, zoe=validate, mike_fin=customer comms standby.

zoe: Dry-run completed — staging diff shows 6 adjustments, no duplicates. Scheduling live backfill 2026-05-11T01:20Z.

infra-bot: backfill summary 2026-05-11T01:36:00Z - reconciled=6 duplicates=0 manual_review=2

mike_fin: Finance verified adjustments; 2 invoices needed small manual memos. Holding customer notifications until I draft language.

kai: Deployed fix to prod-canary and added metric `billing.event_billable_mismatch` + Datadog alert. Also added envelope idempotency key to prevent retry-induced duplicates.

zoe: Closing loop — PR merged, alert in place, follow-up ticket FIN-802 to refactor batcher aggregation logic. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
